title: Distribution International
content:
Distribution International is a major North American supplier and fabricator of insulation and related materials. The company serves industrial, marine, commercial, and government customers and offers aerogel insulation products through its warehouse and branch network.

  • Coverage Area: United States
  • Focus Areas: Industrial insulation, marine insulation, mechanical systems, custom fabrication, pipe insulation, vessel insulation, and aerogel blanket distribution
  • Current Brands Represented: Aspen Aerogels (Pyrogel®, Cryogel®), Armacell (ArmaGel®), Johns Manville, Owens Corning, Rockwool, and 3M
  • Official Website: https://www.distributioninternational.com
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
